posts.rationale: This is a pack-hero post. The calm sentence-case headline is the message and the large bag is the proof. The B and Zn hexagons repeat the chemistry cue from the pack. I cut the image copy to a short headline and one line that adds new information, which freed space for a full-bleed 4:3 photo slot so the bag can be shown larger. The full label description (including Zn-Sülfat) and the analysis advice moved to the caption. No numbers, doses or claims are used, only facts.json statements.
critique: high: The body line repeats the headline. 'Bor ve çinko, tek karışımda.' is followed by 'Bor (B) ve çinko (Zn) içeren … karışımı', so a phone reader gets the same idea twice and the image carries extra words with no new information.

medium: The bag is smaller than DESIGN asks for. It shows about 680px tall, around 50% of the artboard against the 55–75% target, and sits in a 4:3 slot that is not full width (left 20px, width 1040px).

medium: The text-to-photo spacing is uneven. The text is 2 lines longer than it needs to be, so the space between the body and the top of the bag doesn't follow the brand scale, and the space between the bag and the sign-off is a different size.
medium: The B/Zn badges float in the top-right with no alignment to the headline, and an empty pocket sits under them, next to the 2-line body.
low: The intro's spacing between eyebrow and rule is set inside the component, but the stack used ad-hoc margins on several elements, making later edits fragile.

posts.rationale: The carousel follows one line from the label: cover statement, then the exact label sentence, then why analysis matters, then the call to read the label. This pass fills the frame with larger type instead of adding decoration. The quote and headline sizes now give each slide one dominant element. The counter, footer line, sign-off and green band keep the same positions on every slide. No doses, timings or crop advice appear, because the brief and FACTS exclude them.
critique: high: Slides 2, 3 and 4 have accidental empty space. On slide 2, about 300px is empty between the paragraph (ending near y 840) and the footer line (y 1148). Slide 4 has a similar gap below the green subline. The text clusters at the top and the slides look unfinished on a phone.
medium: Slide 2: the quoted label sentence is the focal point but it is only 72px, set inside a heavy left border. The paragraph under it ends on the lone word 'öneriyor.'
medium: Slide 3: the 80px headline is weak next to the slide 4 headline. The B/Zn badge row floats at y 832 with no clear relationship to the text above or the footer below.
low: The two content slides start at different heights from the cover and closing slides for no clear reason, so the sequence feels uneven when swiped.
low: carousel-font-drift warning: the cover headline uses Archivo display capitals, while slides 2–4 use Montserrat sentence case.
low: Cover: 'ÖNCE ANALİZ,' (display capitals) and 'sonra uygulama.' (Montserrat) split one sentence across two type styles, which comes close to the rule against mixing styles in one headline.

posts.rationale: One idea per slide, each tied to a label rule: a forest cover previews the three rules as hexagon pictograms, three paper slides each pair a centred hexagon icon on a mist field with a full-width 128px display rule, and the close makes "3 YIL" the single loud element above a calm label reminder. The full-width mist field plus wider type removes the empty right column without inventing content. All copy is quoted or shortened from FACTS storage statements; no numbers beyond 5, 45 and 3 (and slide counters) are used.
critique: high: Content slides 2–4 have a big empty right column and a ~240px gap above the footer band (linter: large-void on slide 3). The headline block sits in the left half and the slide feels unfinished.

high: The image brief asks for a simple icon on every slide, but the rule slides only have numbered hexagons. Their numbers 1/2/3 also clash with the counter ("1" sits on slide 2/5), which gives two numbering systems.
medium: Cover: the large tint hexagon and the small green hexagon are decoration with no meaning. The tint hexagon collides with "DOĞRU", and the upper left is empty.
medium: Closing slide: the rounded green-deep CTA panel looks like a UI button (a DESIGN don't). The green hexagon next to "3 YIL" has no purpose.
medium: "AYRI VE ERİŞİLMEZ" is awkward Turkish and does not match the label wording.
low: Headlines at 112px feel timid next to the 1080 width; the hierarchy jump to the 52px subhead is weak.
